input.prompt: Locked-camera 16:9 ambient overlay for an ORIGINAL colorful bamboo-forest tower-defense map. Plain near-black compositing background. Animate ONLY separated environmental effects: bamboo leaves swaying gently, loose leaves drifting diagonally, a few lantern glows softly pulsing, small water ripples/koi shadows crossing, tiny firefly-like motes, one slow waterwheel silhouette rotation. Calm loop-friendly non-cinematic motion. No roads, buildings, characters, text, UI, camera movement, zoom or cuts. Designed for compositing over a static Unity map.
